$comment: EngineOS MCP baseline. Copy entries into ~/.claude/settings.json mcpServers (or `claude mcp add`). NEVER put literal tokens/connection strings here — env-var references only. Entries marked $verify use community servers whose exact package name/transport should be confirmed before trusting; pin a version once chosen. Connect only the servers a given machine actually needs.

context7.$when: Live, version-correct library docs while coding.

github.$when: PRs, issues, CI status from the terminal.

chrome-devtools.$when: Verify UI changes in a real browser (screenshots, console, network).

nestjs.$when: NestJS scaffolding, docs, and security checklists.

postgres.$when: Postgres schema/data introspection. Point at a READ-ONLY role.

oracle.$when: Oracle DB introspection (e.g. Tasy schema work).
oracle.$verify: no official Oracle MCP server. Confirm a community server (e.g. mcp-server-oracle via uvx) and ensure Oracle Instant Client is installed and on PATH/LD_LIBRARY_PATH.

docker.$when: Inspect/manage local containers, images, compose stacks.
docker.$verify: community server (QuantGeekDev/docker-mcp). Talks to the local Docker socket — grants broad control; connect only on trusted machines.

kubernetes.$when: Inspect/operate clusters; uses the current kubeconfig context.
kubernetes.$verify: community server (Flux159/mcp-server-kubernetes). Inherits full kubeconfig permissions — point at a read-only/limited context for safety.

azure.$when: Query/manage Azure resources. Auth via Azure CLI (`az login`) credentials.

aws.$when: AWS resource/docs access. Auth via the local AWS profile/SSO or env credentials.
aws.$verify: AWS Labs publishes several focused servers (awslabs.core-mcp-server, .aws-documentation-mcp-server, etc.). Pick the ones you need.

gcp.$when: Query GCP resources. Auth via Application Default Credentials (`gcloud auth application-default login`).
gcp.$verify: no single canonical GCP MCP server — confirm a community/official package (e.g. Google's MCP Toolbox) before pinning.

jira.$verify: community server (sooperset/mcp-atlassian) covering Jira + Confluence. Use a scoped API token.

slack.$when: Read/post to Slack channels, search messages.

discord.$when: Read/post to Discord channels via a bot.
discord.$verify: community server (e.g. barryyip0625/mcp-discord). Confirm package + required bot intents.
